dispositions.dismissed_comment: SHA-256 keys an in-memory cache by API origin and a 192-bit random Runner bearer. The original bearer authenticates requests; this digest never verifies a password. Reviewed at commit 4be68ca3; see specs/004-runner-free-pro/tdd/security-alert-disposition.md.

SHA-256 identifies a local keyring record for a 192-bit random Runner bearer, not a password verifier. Authentication still needs the original bearer. Reviewed at commit 4be68ca3; see specs/004-runner-free-pro/tdd/security-alert-disposition.md.

SHA-256 verifies the content address of serialized private schedule payloads, not passwords. Signed manifest and execution bindings are validated separately. Reviewed at 4be68ca3; see specs/004-runner-free-pro/tdd/security-alert-disposition.md (formerly #25).
